address: 62 Wangsingkham Road, Pa Tan, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50300, Thailand
bio: This halal kitchen next to the Ping River is one for beef fans. With indoor and outdoor dining, the big outdoor kitchen cooks a creative à la carte menu with balanced flavours. The beef fat rice topped with egg yolk has a smoky flavour. The spicy Thai soup with beef shank is packed with spice aroma....
